name: Anita Sharma
summary: This prescription treats a mild stomach infection. Take the medicines as shown in the schedule and drink plenty of fluids.

terms.definition: Irritation of the stomach and intestines that causes loose stools, cramps and sometimes vomiting.

checklist: Drink ORS after every loose stool
notes: Seek medical help if there is blood in the stool or you cannot keep fluids down.
follow_up: Visit your doctor after 3 days if symptoms continue.
